points.description: Meter table function: holds a meter entry per flow / collects flow statistics, used by the controller for network management such as QoS (e.g. rate-limiting).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely stated (e.g. 'measures/monitors traffic') without mentioning per-flow meters/statistics or QoS/rate-limiting.

points.description: Flow pipeline function: a series of flow tables containing rules (match fields) and actions, used for packet forwarding / deciding what actions are applied to packets (the switch's routing logic).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says flow tables 'store rules' or 'handle packets' without linking to forwarding/actions.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both functions: meter table (per-flow meter entries/statistics for QoS such as rate-limiting) and flow pipeline (flow tables with rules/actions for forwarding). Give half of a part if it is vague or only partly correct. Give no marks for a part that is missing, swapped between the two tables, or wrong.
